spans.text: Everyone still got the energy to keep going?
I'm like a toy about to fall apart any second now. You can probably take a piece off me and stick it onto someone else.
Don't make it sound so scary, Miss Lewis.
We're all civilian Dolls manufactured by different companies with varying standards. It's unlikely that our parts are compatible.
...I'm not actually donating you my parts!
A metaphor... It's just a metaphor!
What's stopping us from moving forward if we still can?
Yeah. It's not like we had any rest as civilian Dolls.
This is but a mere experiment, why don't we give it our best?
A miracle might even occur if we do so.
...Makes sense. In my previous occupation, you never knew what sort of combination worked. Some may look awful, but others might just work wonderfully!
We might not hold a candle to the AR Team in terms of specs, but I don't want us to lose when it comes to spirit and determination.
Of course. Giving up really is the worst!
